changeSet.author: floxboard
changeSet.comment: Purge dangling approved access requests where user is no longer a collaborator
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM whiteboard_access_requests ar WHERE ar.status = 'APPROVED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM whiteboard_collaborators wc WHERE wc.whiteboard_id = ar.whiteboard_id AND wc.user_id = ar.user_id );

changeSet.author: floxboard
changeSet.comment: Remove redundant collaborator records where user is already the board owner
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM whiteboard_collaborators wc USING whiteboard w WHERE wc.whiteboard_id = w.id AND wc.user_id = w.owner_id;
